attchmntText: Abhishek Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Mahaalaxmi Texpro Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026. The company reported a net loss of 32.08 for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and a net loss of 89.52 for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Earnings per share stood at negative 0.95 for the quarter and negative 2.66 for the half year. The Board also approved the Statement of Assets and Liabilities and the Statement of Cash Flows for the half year. A Limited Review Report was issued by statutory auditors M/s AR N A & Associates, confirming that the financial results comply with Indian Accounting Standards and disclose all required information without material misstatement. The meeting commenced at 2.00 p.m. and concluded at 3.39 p.m.
